gloss: imperial dolls; the emperor and empress pair of a hina display

definitions.gloss: imperial dolls; the emperor and empress pair of a hina display
definitions.explanation: The two dolls placed on the top tier of a {雛人形|ひなにんぎょう} display for the March 3 Doll Festival, dressed as the Heian imperial couple. Sold and spoken of as a pair, and often the only dolls a household displays.

examples.japanese: {内裏雛|だいりびな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一番上|いちばんうえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: We put the emperor and empress dolls on the top tier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{内裏雛|だいりびな}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{飾|かざ}っています→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: Our place is small, so we only display the imperial pair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雛人形|ひなにんぎょう}→雛人形：14830_hinaningyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{内裏雛|だいりびな}、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}→三人官女：30616_sanninkanjo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The imperial pair goes on the top tier of the doll display, with the three court ladies on the tier below.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内裏雛|だいりびな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display the imperial pair
- {内裏雛|だいりびな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to put the dolls away (traditionally soon after March 3)
- {親王|しんのう}⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧: a display consisting of the imperial pair only

CULTURAL NOTE:
In conversation the two are usually called お{内裏|だいり}⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ (the male doll) and お{雛|ひな}{様|さま} (the female doll). Placement differs by region: in Tokyo-style displays the male doll sits on the viewer's left, in Kyoto-style displays on the right.
